description_en: Queries execution logs by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns. The current POP contract exposes only the task and workspace identifiers and returns default log segments
description_zh: 使用 RunSemanticJob 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 返回的 ExecutorJobId 查询执行日志。当前 POP 契约仅暴露任务与工作空间标识，返回默认日志片段
name: GetSemanticJobLog

parameters.help_en: The executor job ID. Use the Data.ExecutorJobId from the RunSemanticJob response or the ExecutorJobId from a ListSemanticJobRuns record
parameters.help_zh: 执行器任务标识，使用 RunSemanticJob 响应的 Data.ExecutorJobId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 ExecutorJobId
parameters.name: executor_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the task belongs. Use the ProjectId from the CreateSemanticJob response or a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 ProjectId
parameters.name: project_id

schema.description_en: The standard response for querying execution logs. Data contains the list of log segments returned by the executor
schema.description_zh: 查询执行日志的标准响应。Data 为执行器返回的日志片段列表

Data.description_en: The list of log segments returned by the executor. The current POP contract does not expose sqlIndex or offset externally. Log segments are returned based on the default behavior of the operation
Data.description_zh: 执行器返回的日志片段列表。当前 POP 契约未对外暴露 sqlIndex、offset，按接口默认行为返回日志片段

LogContent.description_en: The raw log text returned in this response
LogContent.description_zh: 本次返回的原始日志文本

LogEnd.description_en: Indicates whether the current log segment has been read to the end. A value of true indicates that no more content follows this segment
LogEnd.description_zh: 当前日志片段是否已读取到末尾；为 true 表示该片段没有更多后续内容

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
